card.title: Relief Is Suspicious
card.instruction: Treat every reassuring development as evidence that the real threat has merely changed shape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The neighbours liked my speech? I thought they'd vote me off the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've asked you to chair next month's meeting. Please say yes; I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So they're keeping me where they can watch me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you and handle complaints.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've given me a minder. Will you be reporting my mistakes to them?
